_comment: NPC dialogue for captain_dael (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Cinderhold's captain wants the ash road walked by someone who is not one of her own soldiers -- and she wants a witness.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Reach Visited Cinderhold. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: The chanting starts at dusk and the walls answer it. Dael wants it stopped, not studied.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 7 Frost Shaman. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: The charms Dael's smiths copy keep the mortar from singing, but the copies need originals.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Gather 4 Shaman Charm. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Cinderhold's shields are laced with lizard hide. The lacing is wearing out.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 8 Slag Lizard. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Six ash shards from the glass fields, for Dael's armourer to test a theory.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Gather 6 Ash Shard. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Four relics out of the rubble, before the Choir gets a use out of them.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Gather 4 Scorched Relic. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: The chant is louder than it was and it is coming from further away. Dael wants the mouth of it stopped.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 10 Frost Shaman. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Three ingots of warden steel, still warm, still in Choir hands. Dael wants to know how they are making it.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Gather 3 Warden-Steel Ingot. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Cinderhold's road to Ashvow is shut by something with horns and a reasonable grasp of tactics.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 6 Ash Minotaur. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Four Choir sigils off four different beasts. Dael says a sigil on a beast is a signature.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Gather 4 Choir Sigil. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Ashvow is where the ash started and where the money still is. Walk in with your hand off your sword.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Reach Visited Ashvow. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Dael's last sweep of the salt flats before she calls the road lost. She does not want company and she does not want witnesses left alive.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 12 Raider Brute. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: There is a sanctum under the city, and the singing in it keeps time with the chant you have been killing.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Reach Entered Choir Sanctum. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Captain Dael
1.text: Word from the south: Ashvow's own garrison turned. Dael asks for the ones in Choir grey to be dealt with first.

2.speaker: Captain Dael
2.text: Slay 10 Choir Legionnaire. Come back to me when it is done.

barks.text: Cinderhold holds because someone stands on the wall. Today that's me.
I don't have soldiers to spare. I have refugees with spears.
You want the Monastery cleared? Bring me back proof it can be held.
